_: DOORS THIS MACHINE KNOWS ARE OPEN, WHICH THE SERVER HAS NOT MENTIONED.
Copy to substrate/door-states.local.json. That file is gitignored, because it is an
assertion about ONE server at ONE moment and a stranger cloning this repository has no
such knowledge. The shape is committed; the claim is not.
WHY IT HAS TO EXIST. The keeper learns a door's position from BP_SECTOR_MOVE, and there
is a class of open door it can never hear about. duke2.kod gates the Duke's Feast Hall
on RID_DUKE4 @IsLocked -- SomethingTryGo returns TRUE and refuses the move while that is
set -- and the floor sectors are only what the door LOOKS like. They move when an actor
walks the door square. Unlock the hall any other way and no SetSector fires, nothing
accumulates in plSector_changes, SendSectorChanges replays nothing on entry, and our
bake goes on enforcing a wall the server would have let us walk through.
The key is a state from the routing table's stepMaskVariants for that room:
node tools/m59-doorbake.mjs        # lists them per room
ANYTHING THE SERVER SAYS ABOUT THAT ROOM REPLACES THIS. It is a stand-in for silence,
not an override -- the server is the authority and this is the weakest claim here.
